title: Session/AccountInfo/WebSocketCapability missing #[non_exhaustive]
description: Session, AccountInfo, and WebSocketCapability in request.rs are Deserialize-only structs that represent RFC 8620 §2 wire types. They have no #[non_exhaustive] annotation. RFC 8620 §2 server session fields will grow over time (extensions, new base-protocol fields). Without #[non_exhaustive], adding any new field to these structs is a semver-breaking change. All three should be #[non_exhaustive].
